developer_explanation: Developer deliberately interrupted slow full-grid diagnostic readback. Singularity descendants survived original launcher cleanup and were subsequently terminated after ownership verification; developer reports all identified PIDs exited.

cost_attribution_correction.finding: Host stage read-output identifies where the program was waiting, not the division between pending simulated compute and data transfer. The 534.71s aggregate cannot be described as pure transfer cost.
cost_attribution_correction.required_evidence: Same-layout no-op baseline and controlled call/thread measurements as needed before cost decomposition.
cost_attribution_correction.environment: Continue workstation single simulator. Developer reports read-only host capacity inspection only; alternate host lacks verified SDK/runtime and is not an accepted execution environment.
